question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Bibliophile
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• 'Bibliophile' refers to a person who loves or collects books. The English meaning of bibliophile is a lover of books; a book collector (पुस्तक प्रेमी).

 
 
• **Example:** As a bibliophile, he always treasures the first edition of every book he buys.
 
 
 
• A 'Booklover', which is the correct answer, is a person who enjoys reading. Its English meaning is someone who loves to read and is passionate about books (किताबों का शौकीन).
 
 
• **Example:** My best friend is a booklover; her house is filled with all genres of literature.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• 'Bubbly' is a person who is full of cheerful high spirits (खुशमिजाज).
 
• 'Illiterate' is a person who is unable to read or write (निरक्षर).
 
• 'Non-reader' is a person who does not have a habit of reading or does not enjoy reading (गैर पाठक).
